combinations.name: Lithium
combinations.description: A well-documented seizure trigger — reports of seizures and blackouts on lithium are consistent enough to take seriously. If you take lithium, sit this one out.

combinations.name: Cannabis
combinations.description: Strengthens the trip unpredictably. A normal dose at the peak can restart or sharply amplify it, and it's the most common factor in difficult trips. If you add it, use a fraction of your usual amount.

combinations.name: SSRIs
combinations.description: Long-term SSRI use tends to weaken or shorten the LSD experience. Some people notice little change. Weaker, not dangerous.
